item.description:
1.1.10

  • Show release notes for the last 10 updates in the Sparkle update prompt, so you can see everything that changed when skipping versions.

1.1.9

  • Only show and monitor frames registered to your display name in Settings and status checks, so you no longer see or poll other family members' frames.
  • Keep your frames linked to your account when you rename your display name in Settings.

1.1.8

  • Faster startup: the gallery opens immediately from your local cache while verifying server connection and session status in the background.
  • Improved connection reliability with shared HTTP/2 connection pooling and automatic sync recovery when the server comes back online.

1.1.7

  • Fix macOS in-app update signature validation (-67050) across ad-hoc signed releases
  • Enforce and cryptographically verify Sparkle Ed25519 update signatures at build time

1.1.6

Embed readable HTML release notes in Sparkle appcast.xml (#13)

  • Embed readable HTML release notes in Sparkle appcast.xml
  • Skip Vercel builds when server/ is unchanged
  • Keep appcast untouched on PR branches and sync origin/main before release packaging
